description.value: Pulled from a flooded ruin along the Drowned Coast, pitted with rust that should have ruined it and somehow didn't touch the mechanism at all. Every confirmed kill leaves a faint, almost musical chime nobody else can hear. Local rumor says it's counting toward something, and nobody's found anyone willing to find out what happens at the total.

cinderfall.define: Salt-Corroded Rifle · Unique · Drowned Coast Recovery
cinderfall.special: Every confirmed kill leaves a faint chime only the wielder hears, said to be counting toward something. Deliberately unresolved in the fiction; no trigger, total or payoff is authored.
